verdict.rationale: Ramp ships developer tooling (CLI, MCP servers, API) where a telemetry opt-out setting would be a fair ask, but the evidence pack contains no mention of any telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism for these tools or for Ramp's own product usage — the closest topic (ai-usage tracking) is customer-supplied AI spend data flowing INTO Ramp, not Ramp's own telemetry about the user.
